quotes.text: Every ground-truth row stores its task, granularity, and the patient, encounter, or question it derives from

parsed.rationale: A route from each task instance to its source patient, encounter and question is documented, and the release is versioned (v1.3) with pinned ontology snapshots. The original source decks (USMLE-style board questions, flashcards) are not named or versioned and the material is not distributed, so the source itself lacks a name and version; scored 1.
